Name: (AT) Seasonal-Mystery Shack Farmhouse (Gravity Falls)
Author: armoredlovecat
Description:
This mod replaces the vanilla farmhouse 1,2 and 3 with the Seasonal Mystery Shack inspired by Gravity Falls using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].

To change the texture, you can use the Paint Bucket tool on the house. This tool is purchasable from Robin.

Works best with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20676]Caramel Reshade[/url]﻿.
